name: Cleaner Production Candidate
prompt: Using the provided approved parent concept as reference, generate a cleaner production-ready isolated concept of a first person right hand forearm. Preserve the approved art direction and reusable components, but simplify clutter, remove overlap, and make the asset stand on its own on a plain background. Keep the materials stylized skin, leather wraps, cloth accents, simple forged metal details, the mood grounded, crafted, stylized, warm, readable, and the silhouette game-readable for first-person distance.
